item.title: Automakers race to prepare for looming microchip shortage
item.description: Automakers face potential DRAM chip shortages as AI data centers drive price spikes, raising production risks and costs for GM, Ford and EV makers.

item.title: U.S. consumer confidence rebounds in February
item.description: U.S. consumer confidence rebounded more than expected in February amid an improvement in households' perceptions of the labor market, a survey showed on Tuesday.

item.title: Trump’s second term economy: growth, jobs lag
item.description: Trump’s second-term economy shows solid GDP growth and AI investment gains, but weak job growth, stubborn inflation and tariff uncertainty cloud outlook.

item.title: Fed’s Bostic warns of possible rise in structural unemployment
item.description: Atlanta Fed President Raphael Bostic says AI-driven structural shifts could raise U.S. unemployment, limiting the Federal Reserve’s ability to offset job losses with rate cuts.

item.title: Home Depot’s professional contractor bet pays off in Q4
item.description: Home Depot beats Q4 earnings estimates on strong Pro demand and repair spending, maintains 2026 outlook as tariffs and housing weakness loom.

item.title: New 10% tariff sows more trade policy confusion
item.description: Trump’s 10% global import tariff takes effect as the White House signals plans to raise it to 15%, fueling trade uncertainty after a Supreme Court ruling.

item.title: U.S. single-family home price growth slows in December
item.description: U.S. single-family home price gains slowed in December, but tight inventory and limited new construction may prevent a national housing price decline.

item.title: Google data center coming to Pine Island
item.description: Google plans a 250,000-square-foot data center in Pine Island, MN, bringing jobs, tax revenue and infrastructure upgrades to the growing market.

item.title: St. Louis Park office sells for $2.88M amid 75% vacancy
item.description: A 206,656-square-foot office building in St. Louis Park’s Metropoint campus sold for $2.88M as high vacancy weighs on the Twin Cities office market.

item.title: Just Sold: Renovated Mahtomedi rentals draw $10.4M
item.description: An entity related to Wayzata-based North Shore Development Partners has closed on the $10.4 million sale of one of its most recent projects in Mahtomedi.
